messages:
Mia L.: Hey team — can someone pin a shortlink to the service-tiles dashboard in Prod? I can't locate the region heatmap tile for the on-call handover.
Sam T.: Which panel exactly? service-overview -> model-inference-heatmap?
Mia L.: Yes, the 'model_region_heatmap' panel. When I open the shortlink I get a 403: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd123/service-tiles
Grafana Bot: Generated link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd123/service-tiles?viewPanel=5
Raj P.: Looks like an RBAC issue. @Hana K. can you check prod grafana group membership for Mia?
Hana K.: On it. I can see Mia is in the engineering group which only has viewer in staging. I'll add prod-grafana/read for Mia L. shortly.
Mia L.: Thanks!
Sam T.: Quick note on alerts — the tile shows frequent p50 spikes. Are we alerting on p50 or p95 currently?
Mia L.: It's currently p50 > 200ms for 5m. I'd like to try p95 > 250ms for 10m to reduce noise.
Raj P.: Can you paste the current rule so I can update?
Mia L.: Sure — current PromRule snippet:
````
expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service)) > 0.2
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
````
Sam T.: Proposed change:
````
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[10m])) by (le, service)) > 0.25
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: ticket
````
Hana K.: Sounds reasonable. Want to run it as a canary on prod-service=payments for 24h first?
Mia L.: Yes, canary on payments only. If it looks stable after 24h, roll out to other services.
Raj P.: I'll create a canary rule and update Alertmanager route. Will tag the change and monitor.
Ops Bot: Deploy job started: alert-change-canary (job id: 9876) by Raj P.
Sam T.: Once Mia has prod access I can pin the dashboard to the 'Oncall > Service Health' workspace.
Hana K.: Access granted — Mia L. now has prod-grafana/read :white_check_mark:
Mia L.: Link works now :tada:
Sam T.: Pinning now. Added to workspace 'Oncall > Service Health' (shortlink: https://grafana.redwood.com/s/short/pin123)
Mia L.: Awesome, thanks everyone :heart:
notes: Canary for alert rule to be monitored for 24h; RBAC change applied for prod grafana read access.
